title: An engineer laid off after over 16 years at Google said 'faceless' tech giants see staff as '100% disposable'
description: An engineering manager laid off by Google said the tech giant sees staff as "100% disposable." Justin Moore said on LinkedIn that he was laid off through an automatic account deactivation. Moore was one of 12,000 people affected by the company's mass layoff last week.
